# A method on a type reads its receiver and the page's state, run on every
# target. testdata/type_method_receiver.txtar is the compiled half: a golden
# shows the parameter list, and only running it shows that `bonus` was read off
# the page rather than the receiver, which has no such field.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Pt {
    x int
    y int
}

var bonus = 1
var n = 1

func Pt.sum(q Pt) int {
    return q.x + q.y + bonus
}

func list[T].pick() => this[n]

func list[T].second() T {
    var i = 0
    for var x = this {
        if i == 1 {
            return x
        }
        i += 1
    }
    return this[0]
}

func Pt.flip(q Pt) Pt {
    var r = Pt{x=q.y, y=q.x}
    r.x += 1
    return r
}

component main ui.node {
    var p = Pt{x=1, y=2}
    var xs = [10, 20, 30]
    var sum = 0
    var picked = 0
    var second = 0
    var flipped = 0

    effect(@mount {
        sum = p.sum()
        picked = xs.pick()
        second = xs.second()
        flipped = p.flip().x
    })

    ui.text(value="{sum} {picked}")
}

func testTypeMethodsReadTheirReceiver(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.sum == 4)
    t.assert(c.picked == 20)
    t.assert(c.second == 20)
    t.assert(c.flipped == 3)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
